blogPosts.title: How Much Do Custom Kitchen Cabinets Cost in Seaford, VIC?
blogPosts.excerpt: Planning a kitchen renovation in Seaford? Discover what custom cabinets really cost, from materials to installation, with pricing tips from local cabinet makers.
body: Planning a kitchen renovation in Seaford and wondering what custom cabinets will cost? You are not alone — it is one of the most common questions we hear at our Rutherford Road workshop. The cost of custom kitchen cabinets in Seaford typically ranges from $4,500 for a modest galley kitchen up to $15,000 or more for a large, fully fitted space with premium finishes. Several factors influence the final price, including the size of your kitchen, the materials you choose, the complexity of the design, and whether you need features like soft-close drawers, pull-out pantries, or custom corner solutions. Understanding these variables helps Seaford homeowners plan their renovation budget with confidence.

One of the biggest variables in kitchen cabinet pricing is the material. In Seaford, where coastal humidity can be a factor, moisture-resistant MDF and marine-grade plywood are popular choices for their durability and affordability. Solid timber options like Victorian Ash or Tasmanian Oak add warmth and character but come at a premium. Laminate finishes remain the most budget-friendly option, offering a huge range of colours and textures while being easy to clean and maintain. At Core2 Cabinets, we help Seaford homeowners navigate these choices, ensuring the material suits both the budget and the specific demands of a kitchen environment in Melbourne's south-east.

The layout of your kitchen plays a significant role in determining cost. A straightforward galley or L-shaped kitchen in a Seaford home will naturally cost less than a large U-shaped or island-based layout. Custom cabinets are priced based on the running metre — each linear metre of cabinetry requires materials, labour, hardware, and finishing. In Seaford, most kitchen renovations we complete fall in the 3 to 5 running metre range for standard homes, while larger properties near the foreshore or newer estates can require 6 or more running metres. We always take precise measurements during our free on-site consultation to give you an accurate, fixed-price quote.

Hardware is another factor that can shift your budget significantly. Basic hinges and drawer runners are included in any kitchen cabinet build, but upgrading to Blum soft-close systems, pull-out spice racks, carousel corner units, and under-bench waste systems adds to the overall cost. These features are incredibly popular with our Seaford clients because they dramatically improve the functionality of the kitchen. A well-designed corner pull-out, for example, can transform an otherwise wasted space into prime storage. We always recommend investing in quality hardware — it is the moving parts that get the most use, and reliable brands like Blum and Hettich come with lifetime warranties.

Do not forget to factor in installation costs when budgeting for your Seaford kitchen renovation. Custom cabinets require professional installation to ensure everything is level, plumb, and securely fixed. Installation typically adds 15 to 20 percent to the manufacturing cost. At Core2 Cabinets, installation is always included in our quoted price — we measure, build, and install everything from our Seaford base, so there is no subcontracting or surprise charges. We also coordinate with your plumber and electrician if your renovation involves moving services, ensuring a smooth, coordinated fit-out. For Seaford homeowners, having one team handle the entire process from workshop to installation saves time, money, and headaches.

The best way to get an accurate cost for custom kitchen cabinets in Seaford is to book a free on-site consultation. During this visit, our team will measure your kitchen, discuss your design ideas, show you material samples, and provide a detailed, fixed-price quote — all at no obligation. Every kitchen is different, and every Seaford home has its own quirks and opportunities. Whether you are in a classic weatherboard near Seaford station or a modern build in one of the newer estates, we will design cabinets that work with your space and your budget. Call Core2 Cabinets on 0487 208 475 or visit our Seaford workshop on Rutherford Road to get started today.

blogPosts.title: Choosing the Right Timber for Your Seaford Bathroom Vanity
blogPosts.excerpt: Your bathroom vanity needs to handle Seaford's coastal humidity. Learn which timbers and materials perform best in Melbourne's south-eastern climate.
body: Your bathroom vanity is one of the most visible and hardworking pieces in your Seaford home. It needs to look fantastic, withstand daily exposure to water and humidity, and stand the test of time. Choosing the right timber or material for your bathroom vanity is especially important in Seaford, where the coastal climate means higher humidity levels than suburbs further inland. At Core2 Cabinets, we have built hundreds of vanities for Seaford bathrooms, and we have seen first-hand which materials perform best in our local conditions. Here is our guide to selecting the perfect material for your next vanity project in Seaford.

Marine-grade plywood is an excellent choice for bathroom vanities in Seaford. It is specifically engineered to resist moisture and will not delaminate or swell the way standard MDF can when exposed to repeated humidity. Marine ply forms a solid, stable substrate that takes paint and laminate finishes beautifully. For Seaford homeowners who want a painted vanity in a bold colour or a clean white finish, marine-grade plywood provides the ideal foundation. It is also lighter than solid timber, making it easier to install in bathrooms where access might be tight — a common consideration in older Seaford homes with narrower hallways and doorways.

If you are after the warmth and character of real timber, Victorian Ash and Tasmanian Oak are popular choices for Seaford bathroom vanities. Both are Australian hardwoods with beautiful grain patterns that respond well to clear sealers and natural finishes. However, solid timber requires proper sealing on all surfaces — including the underside and inside of drawers — to prevent moisture ingress. In Seaford's coastal environment, we recommend a two-pack polyurethane finish for maximum water resistance. It is worth noting that solid timber will develop a natural patina over time, which many Seaford homeowners find adds to the charm and character of their bathroom.

Laminate and engineered surfaces like Laminex and Polytec offer a practical, low-maintenance option for Seaford bathroom vanities. These materials are highly resistant to water, scratches, and staining, and they come in an enormous range of colours, textures, and timber-look finishes. For Seaford families with young children or busy bathrooms, laminate is often the most practical choice — it wipes clean easily and will not require resealing over time. Modern laminates have come a long way in terms of appearance, with many products convincingly replicating the look of natural timber at a fraction of the cost and with significantly less maintenance.

When designing your Seaford bathroom vanity, consider the layout and size of your bathroom carefully. Smaller Seaford bathrooms — common in the area's older housing stock — benefit from wall-hung vanities that free up floor space and create a sense of openness. Larger bathrooms in newer Seaford developments can accommodate double vanities with ample storage underneath. At Core2 Cabinets, we custom-build every vanity to fit the exact dimensions of your space, including accommodating existing plumbing locations to minimise the cost of moving pipes. We will visit your Seaford home, take precise measurements, and design a vanity that works perfectly with your bathroom's layout and style.

The best way to choose the right material for your Seaford bathroom vanity is to see and touch the options in person. Visit our Seaford workshop on Rutherford Road where we keep an extensive range of material samples, from marine ply to solid timber to laminate finishes. Our team can walk you through the pros and cons of each option in the context of your specific bathroom and budget. We will also show you examples of completed vanity projects for other Seaford homes, so you can see how different materials look and perform in real bathrooms. Book your free design consultation today by calling Core2 Cabinets on 0487 208 475.

blogPosts.title: 5 Smart Storage Solutions for Small Seaford Homes
blogPosts.excerpt: Struggling with storage in your compact Seaford home? Discover five custom cabinetry solutions that make every centimetre count.
body: Living in a smaller Seaford home does not mean you have to compromise on storage. In fact, some of the most clever cabinetry we have built at our Rutherford Road workshop has been for compact Seaford homes where every square centimetre counts. Whether you are in a classic Seaford unit, a post-war weatherboard, or a modern townhouse, custom storage solutions can dramatically improve how you use and enjoy your space. As Seaford's local cabinet makers, we have developed a range of smart storage ideas specifically suited to the homes and lifestyles of our south-eastern Melbourne community.

Floor-to-ceiling built-in wardrobes are one of the most effective storage solutions for small Seaford bedrooms. By taking the wardrobe to the ceiling, you capture valuable overhead space that is typically wasted with freestanding options. Internal fittings like double-hanging rails, shoe racks, pull-out baskets, and dedicated accessory drawers can double or even triple the usable storage within the same footprint. For Seaford homes with sloping ceilings or unusual angles — common in the area's older housing stock — custom-built wardrobes are the only way to make every nook and cranny work for you and your family.

Under-stair storage is another opportunity that many Seaford homeowners overlook. If your home has a staircase — whether straight, L-shaped, or spiral — the space underneath is prime real estate for custom cabinetry. We have built everything from pull-out pantry units to hidden home office nooks in the under-stair spaces of Seaford homes. This type of custom solution requires precise measurements and skilled craftsmanship to work around structural elements like stringers and support posts, but the result is a seamless, integrated storage system that looks like it was always meant to be there. It is one of our favourite projects to complete for Seaford clients.

In the kitchen, vertical storage is the small Seaford home's best friend. Tall, narrow pantry pull-outs, wall-mounted spice racks, and over-bench overhead cupboards all help you use the vertical space rather than just the floor area. We often design Seaford kitchen renovations with floor-to-ceiling pantry units that maximise every available centimetre. Internal organisers — like tiered shelf inserts, drawer dividers, and pull-out bins — further enhance the functionality of your kitchen storage. A well-designed kitchen in a small Seaford home can actually store more than a poorly planned one twice the size.

Laundry storage is critical in smaller Seaford homes where the laundry often doubles as a mudroom, pet area, or additional utility space. Custom laundry cabinetry with an integrated benchtop, overhead cupboards, and under-sink storage can transform a cramped laundry into an efficient, organised workspace. We also recommend including a pull-out ironing board cabinet or a dedicated broom closet — small touches that make a big difference in daily life. At Core2 Cabinets, we design laundry solutions that work around your existing appliances and plumbing, so you get maximum storage without the cost of major renovations or restructuring.

The key to smart storage in any small Seaford home is working with a local cabinet maker who understands your space. Cookie-cutter solutions from big-box stores simply cannot account for the quirks of Seaford's diverse housing stock — from narrow Federation-era hallways to angled modern ceilings. At Core2 Cabinets, we design every storage solution to fit your home's specific dimensions and your family's specific needs. Visit our Seaford workshop on Rutherford Road to discuss your storage challenges, or book a free home consultation. We will come to your Seaford property, assess the space, and design storage that makes your home work harder for you.

blogPosts.title: Built-In Wardrobes vs Freestanding: Which Is Right for Your Seaford Bedroom?
blogPosts.excerpt: Compare built-in and freestanding wardrobes for Seaford bedrooms. Learn why custom built-ins add value and storage to Melbourne south-east homes.
body: When it comes to bedroom storage in Seaford, the choice between built-in wardrobes and freestanding options is one that nearly every homeowner faces at some point. Both have their merits, but the right choice depends on your bedroom's size, your storage needs, and whether you are renting or owning. As Seaford's local cabinet making specialists, Core2 Cabinets has installed hundreds of built-in wardrobes across the south-eastern suburbs, and we have seen how the right choice can completely transform a bedroom's functionality and appearance for Seaford families.

Built-in wardrobes offer a significant advantage in terms of space efficiency. Because they are designed to fit the exact dimensions of your Seaford bedroom — including awkward alcoves, sloping ceilings, and chimney breasts — they use every available centimetre. A well-designed built-in can include double-hanging sections, shoe drawers, shelf dividers, mirror panels, and even integrated lighting. For Seaford bedrooms where floor space is at a premium, a built-in wardrobe eliminates the dead space that typically surrounds freestanding units, giving you more storage in the same footprint without encroaching on the room.

Freestanding wardrobes have their place, particularly for Seaford renters or those who move frequently. They are portable, require no installation, and can be taken with you when you leave. However, they almost always waste space. The gap between the top of the wardrobe and the ceiling, the space behind and beside it — all of it is lost storage. In Seaford's smaller bedrooms, this wasted space can be the difference between having a clutter-free room and struggling to find room for everything. Freestanding options also tend to be less sturdy, with wobbly frames and limited internal organisation compared to custom built-ins.

From a value perspective, built-in wardrobes are a smart investment for Seaford homeowners. Real estate agents consistently report that homes with quality built-in wardrobes sell faster and at higher prices than those without. In Seaford's competitive property market, a well-fitted bedroom with a custom built-in can be a genuine selling point. The cost of a custom built-in wardrobe from a local Seaford cabinet maker like Core2 Cabinets is surprisingly accessible, with most three-bedroom installations starting from around $3,000 depending on size, materials, and the complexity of the internal fit-out you choose.

The installation process for built-in wardrobes is something many Seaford homeowners worry about, but it is far less disruptive than most people expect. At Core2 Cabinets, we manufacture all components in our Seaford workshop and then install on-site, typically completing a standard bedroom wardrobe in one to two days. There is no mess, no dust, and no need to vacate the room. For Seaford homes with tricky access — narrow staircases, tight corners, or limited parking — our local knowledge and compact workshop vehicles make the process smooth and efficient every time.

Ultimately, if you own your Seaford home and want to maximise your storage while adding long-term value, a custom built-in wardrobe is almost always the superior choice. The difference in daily convenience, space utilisation, and overall room appearance is remarkable. If you are considering built-in wardrobes for your Seaford bedroom, we invite you to visit our Rutherford Road workshop to explore material options, door styles, and internal configurations. Alternatively, book a free measurement and consultation at your Seaford home — we will design a wardrobe that fits your space perfectly and includes everything you need. Call Core2 Cabinets on 0487 208 475 to get started.
